title: QueueMessage
description: Wire format for messages published via @EmitOnSuccess / @emit_on_success when use_queue=True. Per Decision #7, payload MUST be JSON-serializable.

eventName.description: Logical event name. Defaults to ClassName.methodName when not overridden.

payload.description: MUST be JSON-serializable per Decision #7. No functions, undefined, or class instances. Schema-permissive: any JSON value is allowed (including null and 0/empty-string).

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at which the producer built the message.

metadata.description: Optional metadata. Built-in producers populate className, methodName, and topic; user-supplied metadata via queueMetadata is merged in.

className.description: Class on which the decorated method is defined. Empty string for module-level functions.

topic.description: Routing topic. May be auto-derived (ClassName.methodName or service.ClassName.methodName) or explicit; null when neither is set.

service.description: Optional logical service name (from SERVER_DECORATOR_SERVICE / configure()). When set, the auto-topic is prefixed with it. Absent when no service is configured.
